cheapest_decisive_test.action: scripts/run_t20260930_17b_model_family_book.py --stage all on Modal (one container, 8 CPU, 32 GiB): rebuild the T-20260928-30 cohort/liquidity caches, train the three WX_H63 cells plus the B0 parity cell walk-forward, apply each fold model to every trading day of its test quarter, then V1/V2 books at flat10/flat20 (+AR report-only) over 21 offsets, a 20-seed random-rank placebo, K2 vs vol-matched S3 and DSR with 30 trials.
cheapest_decisive_test.pass_condition: pass_pending_spreads if any of the six books passes K1 (offset-median Sharpe at 10 bp >= 0.65 stress and >= 1.19 anchor, and CAGR > 0 at 20 bp in both windows) or K2 (S3 combination edge at 10 bp >= +0.05 in both windows); parity checks must hold (stage-1 RankIC within +-0.002 per cell; B0 V1 flat10 Sharpe within +-0.05 of T-20260928-30 on its windows).
cheapest_decisive_test.falsification_condition: refuted if no book passes K1 or K2; parity failure sets verdict parity_failed and the lead decides.

cost_and_execution_assumptions: Fixed 10 bp per side (K1 Sharpe, K2 edge) and 20 bp per side (CAGR > 0); signal at the close, next-open fills; buffer 150; position <= 1% of 21-day median dollar volume on a $100k account; Abdi-Ranaldo spread costs are report-only (overstated on liquid names, data pitfall #58). A pass is pass_pending_spreads, never paper-ready: measured NBBO spreads on the held names come first.
existing_solution_comparison: Gu-Kelly-Xiu 2020 (RFS): nonlinear families within 0.33-0.40% monthly out-of-sample R2 (GBRT 0.34%, RF 0.33%, NN1 0.33%, NN3 0.40%) versus 0.11% elastic net; all methods agree on a small set of dominant price-trend signals. Avramov-Cheng-Metzker 2023: deep-learning signal profits sit in difficult-to-arbitrage stocks and fade after costs. Grinsztajn 2022: trees stay state-of-the-art on tabular data. Chen-Pelger-Zhu 2024: a different (no-arbitrage SDF) objective, not tested here. No public replication of the six families on this small-cap, cost-aware, 2016-2023 walk-forward panel was found; the local gap is a same-data, same-split, same-target comparison for the owner's 2026-09-29 question.
negative_experiments_checked: oc research directions check model family xgboost lightgbm price volume ranking (2026-09-30): dir:lgbm_price_volume_ranking_small_caps (refuted 2026-09-28, T-20260928-30: both books fail K1/K2 at base and stress cost; ranking signal itself real, placebo 85-100%, death cause is turnover and small-cap cost) and dir:lightgbm_price_volume_recipe_v1_closed (more LightGBM cells on the same feature set closed). Also T-20260928-10 second run (B0 RankIC 0.0200, t 3.12; LambdaRank 0.0078; data layers add nothing) and T-20260928-30. Difference: this step does not reopen the LightGBM recipe; it tests other model families, an expanding training window and a 63-day horizon (lower turnover) on the same panel, an untested part of the owner's question.
objective: T-20260930-17 stage 2, the preregistered continuation of the owner's 2026-09-29 question (other model families): turn the three mechanically selected stage-1 cells XGB/LGBM/CAT_WX_H63 into cost-aware long-only books and judge them by K1/K2 at fixed 10/20 bp. Stage 1 (reviewed by the 19:07 lead round) found no single family beating LightGBM by 0.010 RankIC in any group; only the rank-mean ensemble in WX_H63 did (+0.012, t 4.47). The horizon (63 vs 21 days) and the expanding window moved RankIC more than the family did.
remaining_evidence_gap: Stage 1 measured ranking only on the stress window. Unknown: whether the 2.3x higher H63 RankIC survives fixed costs and turnover in the 2024-26 window, where B0's book already failed (T-20260928-30: V1 flat10 offset-median Sharpe 0.33 anchor, 0.46 stress; K2 -0.63 anchor). Stage-1 IC is concentrated in the illiquid terciles (T3 0.087-0.093; T1 liquid <= 0.012, t < 1).

stop_condition: refuted: pure price-volume ranking gets no more cells or families; ML compute moves to amplifying signals that already pass costs. pass_pending_spreads: one measured-spread task, then a paper proposal only if it still passes.
target_regime_and_horizon: US common stocks, close >= $3 and 21-day dollar ADV >= $1M (T-20260928-10 PIT universe, delisted names kept); monthly rebalance over 21 offsets, 63-day forecast horizon; judged in the 2024-01-08 -> latest anchor window and the stress window from the first predicted date to 2023-08-31.
